benign_pe32.exe
----------------
A copy of distlib's `t32.exe` script-launcher stub, vendored inside pip
(pip/_vendor/distlib/t32.exe). It is an ordinary, unmodified PE32 executable
with a normal import table and section layout, which makes it a realistic but
definitively benign fixture for PE parsing tests.

Source: https://github.com/pypa/distlib (PSF License)

No live malware is ever used as a test fixture in this project.
